title: Limit Theory for Online Expectile Estimation under Short and Long Range Dependence
abstract: arXiv:2610.16030v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Expectiles are tail-sensitive distributional summaries with important applications in financial risk measurement and forecasting, yet statistical theory for their online estimation from dependent data remains limited. We study a one-pass, stochastic-gradient algorithm with constant learning rate $\gamma$ for estimating the marginal expectile of a stationary causal process. The recursion admits a unique stationary causal solution and geometrically forgets its initialization. Under short-range dependence, its last iterate is asymptotically Gaussian at the $\sqrt{\gamma}$ scale, with variance governed by the population curvature and the long-run variance of the expectile score. For long-memory linear processes the scale changes to $\gamma^{\beta-1/2}\ell(1/\gamma)$, with a Gaussian limit arising from a fractional Brownian motion integral. translated_title: 短程与长程依赖下在线期望分位数估计的极限理论
translated_abstract: 期望分位数是一类对尾部敏感的分布概括统计量，在金融风险度量与预测中具有重要应用，但针对依赖数据进行在线估计的统计理论仍然十分有限。本文研究了一种采用恒定学习率 γ 的单遍随机梯度算法，用于估计平稳因果过程的边缘期望分位数。该递归方程存在唯一的平稳因果解，并能以几何速度遗忘其初始化的影响。在短程依赖条件下，其最终迭代值在 √γ 尺度下渐近服从高斯分布，方差由总体曲率和期望分位数得分的长期方差决定。对于长记忆线性过程，尺度变为 γ^(β-1/2)ℓ(1/γ)，其高斯极限由分数布朗运动积分产生。此外，作者进一步推导了多个期望分位数水平下的联合长记忆极限，并刻画了其极限行为。
tldr: 本文建立了恒定步长随机梯度算法在线估计期望分位数的极限理论：短程依赖下迭代值以 √γ 尺度渐近高斯，长记忆下尺度变为 γ^(β-1/2) 且极限由分数布朗运动积分给出，并推广至多水平联合极限。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes limit theory for online expectile estimation via constant-step stochastic gradient descent: under short-range dependence the iterate is asymptotically Gaussian at the √γ scale, while for long-memory processes the scale becomes γ^(β-1/2) with a Gaussian limit derived from a fractional Brownian motion integral, extending to joint limits across multiple levels.
